code:
import argparse

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='{{tool_name}}', description='{{tool_name}} CLI')
    parser.add_argument('--{{input_arg}}', required=True, help='input path')
    parser.add_argument('--{{output_arg}}', required=True, help='output path')
    parser.add_argument('-v', '--verbose', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.verbose:
        print(f'reading {args.{{input_arg}}}')
    # TODO: real work
    print(f'wrote {args.{{output_arg}}}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
